description: A Lean 4 + Mathlib library of machine-checked uniform oscillatory-integral estimates: van der Corput's lemma for every derivative order with explicit constants, non-stationary and nondegenerate stationary phase, uniform decay at fold (A2), cusp (A3) and umbilic (D4) points with the D4 leading term and its closed-form constant, global decay from a pointwise classification of the phase (also for amplitudes in any complex Banach space), front ends in Mathlib's idiom, and explicit bounds for the propagator kernel of the free discrete Schrödinger equation: on Z, |∫_{-π}^{π} e^{i(t cos k + ξk)} dk| ≤ 8(1 + √7)/3 · t^{-1/3} for all t > 0 and real ξ, and on Z^d the d-th power of that constant with t^{-d/3}. The degenerate-point and global bounds are uniform over all linear terms of the phase, as dispersive estimates need. Statements are frozen, timestamped and reviewed blind before their proofs (exceptions are disclosed), and the proofs are replayed by six kernel checkers; a downstream checker verifies that a project depends on exactly the reviewed statements. Proofs and reviews are largely by AI agents; statement fidelity has been reviewed by AI referees, not yet by a human expert.
